extraction.title: SMS workflow reminder retry count tracking
extraction.head: sms-retry-enhanced

greptile.text: Summarizes the PR as adding a retryCount field to WorkflowReminder, a migration for it, and retry logic in scheduleSMSReminders.ts. Gives a confidence score of 2/5, citing aggressive cleanup after one retry and no maximum retry limit.
"This condition deletes reminders with retryCount > 1, meaning reminders are deleted after just one retry attempt." Suggests a higher threshold such as > 3 or > 5.
"No maximum retry limit is enforced. Without a cap (e.g., retryCount < 5), reminders could be retried indefinitely." Flags performance risk from unbounded retries on the retryCount + 1 update.
